findings.issue: Any index-build failure (Notion down at build time) is swallowed with exit 0, so the hourly redeploy promotes a deployment with no index (503 on every search) over the working one.
findings.fix: On Vercel with live configured, exit non-zero on failure so the previous production deployment stays live.

findings.issue: VERCEL_TOKEN is job-level env, so vercel build (runs branch code: prebuild tsx, npm scripts) sees it, plus the pulled preview env (Notion key, owner password). Anyone with push rights to claude/** or devin/** can exfiltrate. Not a fork or pull_request_target risk (push trigger, no fork secrets).
findings.fix: Scope the token to the pull and deploy steps, keep preview env free of the production Notion key or use a read-only integration, document that push access equals secret access.

findings.issue: onnxruntime-node is absent from the traced files of /api/search; could not verify query embedding works on Vercel. Failure degrades to keyword-only with a reported reason, never fixtures.
findings.fix: Check the first preview deploy reports mode hybrid.

findings.issue: Full Notion pages (including Notes, Email, Day Rate) are held in memory for signed links. Not written or logged (verified), but unnecessary exposure.
findings.fix: Keep only id and Images files; use filter_properties on the query.

findings.issue: No test drives bundledLookup (media) with a downgraded page or a failed check. Code reads correct (only snapshot pages, throws 503).
Header entry count comes from the bundle, not intersected with live eligibility. Owner only.
findings.fix: Accept or label it as index count.
